basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Context Engineer & AI Systems Builder | Writes Prose, Ships Code | 3× Founder | Public Portfolio
basics.summary: The prose-and-code combo this role wants. At LumApps I built AI Brain: a temporal knowledge graph unifying 5+ silos into one context pipeline every agent reads and writes. At Beekeeper I shipped an AI Onboarding Specialist that guides every new signup at scale (direct analog to a Wizard-style agent), plus an LLM translation pipeline over docs-as-code (GitHub Actions + OpenAI) that replaced $337K/yr in vendor cost. Public portfolio: blog at anand-creations.com, 4 international conference talks, articles on TowardsAI and Substack, open-source Robogen at EPFL. Opinionated on context windows, harnesses, coding agents, and MCP; author of MCP servers in production.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Designed AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti/Neo4j that unifies 5+ silos (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, product usage) into one time-aware context pipeline every agent reads and writes. Grounds RAG so agents stop hallucinating.

Built and shipped production multi-agent workflows on Python, LangGraph and Google ADK. Tools exposed over MCP servers I authored, agent state streamed to the UI over AG-UI, evals + LangSmith tracing so every context decision reconstructs from the log. 2x conversions, $1M forecast quarterly.
Opinionated on context window management, harnesses, and coding agents. Every context change is instrumented; behavior regressions block merge.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Built AI Onboarding Specialist that guides every new signup through setup at high-touch scale (direct analog to a Wizard-style onboarding agent). 100% of customers guided without adding headcount.

Replaced $337K/yr in vendor translation costs with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks (GitHub Actions + OpenAI, docs-as-code). 12K+ assets translated; product team ships content in new languages without a gatekeeper.
Designed a distributed templating engine that cut customer setup time 90% and powers 15% of all assets on the platform (10M+ users). Full-stack, Product Owner. Systems thinking end to end.
Ran observability and global on-call across multiple codebases. Hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort; engineers now lead features independently. Got tagged by other engineers for code review.

work.name: Dronistics (EPFL spin-off)
highlights: Founding engineer at a startup. Shipped full stack (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, real-time APIs, AWS/Docker/Terraform infra) from empty repo to 500+ real-world deliveries. Multidisciplinary by necessity.
Built the operator UI and the visual materials partners saw. Explained a complex autonomous system to non-technical customers in every demo.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.position: AI Research Engineer, Teaching Assistant & Open Source Maintainer
highlights: Teaching Assistant for Evolutionary Robotics. Supervised 20+ master's students; taught genetic algorithms, neural controllers, and embodied learning hands-on.
Built and open-sourced Robogen, a platform researchers and students use to design, evolve, and 3D-print real robots. Featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Wrote documentation, examples, and onboarding materials so the platform outlived my time on the team. Systems thinking about how knowledge outlives its author.
